# PgPubSub.unlistenAll() method

Stops listening all connected channels, and, if singleListener option is set to true - will release all acquired locks (if any was settled).

**Signature:**

```typescript
unlistenAll(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;
